description: Software.Land live V2 SearchEngine inputs for the historical relevance suite. Not Core default ranking policy.
notes: configured-concepts.json is the runtime merge of src/search/acronymMap.js and compiled extras for keys not already in that map. It is an explicit fixture input, not a Search Core default.
The refreshed concept list does not include testing. omitConfiguredConceptKeys still names testing so a later reintroduction cannot reach the historical engine unnoticed.

NIST aliases match the runtime acronym map: the full name, institute standards, and the key nist. The patch does not add the one-token institute alias. It still omits AppSec ["security"] and repeats institute standards, which is already in the concept file.

relationship-map.json is the runtime authored map plus the composed live search-equivalence pairs. Do not reverse generated maps through synonym-map.json; that file remains the db5a070 provenance snapshot.
expectedTop / topN / titlePrefix values are not generated from engine output.
